hypotheses.I1_layer0_diagonal_execution: For layer 0, diagonal coefficients predict original-five query effects with median cosine at least 0.95 and fidelity at least 0.80.
hypotheses.I2_layer17_diagonal_execution: For layer 17, diagonal coefficients predict original-five query effects with median cosine at least 0.90 and fidelity at least 0.60.
hypotheses.I3_open_vocabulary_execution: For each layer, diagonal coefficients predict all 14 query effects with median cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.I4_interaction_gain: Using the full within-subspace interaction matrices improves all-14 median fidelity over diagonal prediction by at least 0.15 at layer 17.
hypotheses.I5_activation_regime_stability: Top-activation and random-site original-five diagonal cosine differ by no more than 0.10 at each layer.
